summary: CKGSB's marketing team is currently balancing urgent event execution—the Nov 13 European Chamber event and the WIL warm-up video—with strategic visibility work for Asia Star and Intelligent China, while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and resolving IT lockout issues.
summaryDetail: The most immediate priority is driving senior executive registrations for the Nov 13 European Chamber Shanghai event, where Sarah will represent CKGSB; Graeme will share updated figures early next week, and Amber must provide Ms. Singh's bio and headshot. In parallel, the team is wrapping up the knowledge website redesign—incorporating BCI/BSI indices, removing the video section, and refining the menu—with Joseph sharing the HTML inspiration and Joker implementing changes after a 30-minute feedback session. Strategic visibility work for Asia Star and Intelligent China is gaining momentum: Joseph is drafting target prompts and customer profiles, and the team will audit Google Ads conversion tracking once the brief is received. This week also requires finalizing the WIL warm-up video script, publishing the Q3 Business Sentiment Index report, and sending the Sino-Swiss Economic Forum draft report. Looking ahead, the team will review Flow's 2026 report when Joseph returns and consider China-Africa speakers for next year's events after WIL.

decisions.text: Use the new password across all devices and remove unused accounts to avoid repeated lockouts.
Remove the standalone video section; videos will be dispersed by topic instead.
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge and School menus).
Bring BCI and BSI indices into the knowledge section, similar to the school homepage banner.
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the top of the homepage.
Show more articles on the homepage using a pinned article plus latest/spotlight sections.
Asia Star and Intelligent China are the top two program priorities for visibility work.
US partner programs (Stanford, Columbia, Berkeley) are secondary; Berkeley is the preferred third priority if capacity allows.
US partnerships to be put on hold for the first quarter while focusing on China programs.
Sarah will represent CKGSB at the Nov 13 European Chamber Shanghai event
